Recall - Imperious: Which rooms did my princess tell me to tidy, again?
Recall - Vague: Which rooms did my princess say she might want to use, again?
Recall - Sarcastic: Where was it my princess [turned her nose up], again?
Spritz: Learn if a specified room is safe or dangerous.
Tingle: Sense a random rival or noble room.
Scurry: Tidy the safer of two rooms.
Brush: Target a 3x3 area. For each tile, exclude a random non-owner. Enhanced: applies twice.
Sweep: Target a 5x5 area. Remove dirt from all tiles. Enhanced: 7x7 area.
Caffeinate: Gain 2 spoons. Enhanced: does not exhaust.
Rendezvous: Reveal a random player tile with rival adjacency and a random rival tile with player adjacency. Enhanced: target a tile — the closest player/rival tiles are revealed; closer tiles annotated.
Argue: Target a 3x3 area. Annotate neutrals; mark the rest as not neutral.
Accept Help: Target a cross area. Reveal the safest tiles. Future Accept Helps cost 0 this floor.
Eavesdrop: Target a tile. Learn if it's yours without revealing. Get player adjacency info.
Peek: Target a cross area. Find nobles. Exhaust only if nobles found.
Explode: Destroy a tile. Gain 1 Complaint and a Mollify card.
Deliver: Target a tile. If noble, convert to neutral and reveal safely. Gain 2 copper.
Brat: Target a revealed tile. Unreveal it.
Ramble: Add 2 Distraction stacks to the rival.
Glaze: Gain 1 Excuses stack. Protects against the next noble reveal.
Mask: Play another card from your hand for free. Exhaust both.
Nap: Retrieve a card from your exhaust pile.
Read: +1 card draw per turn for 2 floors.
Hydrate: +1 spoon on copper-granting reveals for 2 floors.
Adopt: Reveal 1 random player tile at floor start for 2 floors.
Gaze ↑: Scan Up from a target tile. Annotate the first unrevealed rival; mark the rest as not-rival. Enhanced: also finds the first noble; keeps scanning until both are found.
Gaze ↓: Scan Down from a target tile. Annotate the first unrevealed rival; mark the rest as not-rival. Enhanced: also finds the first noble; keeps scanning until both are found.
Gaze ←: Scan Left from a target tile. Annotate the first unrevealed rival; mark the rest as not-rival. Enhanced: also finds the first noble; keeps scanning until both are found.
Gaze →: Scan Right from a target tile. Annotate the first unrevealed rival; mark the rest as not-rival. Enhanced: also finds the first noble; keeps scanning until both are found.
Fetch ↑: Scan Up from a target tile. Reveal all tiles of the most-common owner type. Enhanced: also draws 1 card.
Fetch ↓: Scan Down from a target tile. Reveal all tiles of the most-common owner type. Enhanced: also draws 1 card.
Fetch ←: Scan Left from a target tile. Reveal all tiles of the most-common owner type. Enhanced: also draws 1 card.
Fetch →: Scan Right from a target tile. Reveal all tiles of the most-common owner type. Enhanced: also draws 1 card.
Pose: Spawn a courtier on a random unrevealed player tile. Enhanced: spawns 2.
Taunt: Tag 4 tiles. If the rival reveals 3 of them, her turn ends early. Enhanced: tag 3 tiles (rival ends turn after 2).
